judgement.reason: The registry supports an S3 storage driver, so moving storage from local disk to S3 is a contained configuration change.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /var/lib/registry (Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The image copies config-dev.yml as its configuration, and no shown line proves that config selects S3 storage instead of the filesystem under /var/lib/registry, so the registry likely stores image blobs on local disk.
